description: This Kotlin source file contains Compose UI components and related functions for the chat interface in an Android app, including chat session management, message display, error reporting, image attachment handling, and auto-send logic.

classes.name: PendingImageAttachment
classes.description: Data class representing an image attachment pending upload, including its ID, filename, MIME type, and Base64 data.

methods.name: resolvePendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Determines if the pending assistant prompt is ready to be auto-sent based on health and run count.

methods.name: dispatchPendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Executes the auto-send of pending assistant prompt if conditions are met, using a provided dispatch function.

methods.name: ChatSheetContent
methods.description: Main composable function rendering the chat interface, managing state and interactions such as message display, session selection, and message sending.

methods.name: ChatThreadSelector
methods.description: Composable for selecting and displaying different chat sessions.

methods.name: ChatErrorRail
methods.description: Displays an error message related to chat issues.
